Officer's narrative
At the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I found a low-speed head-on collision between two passenger vehicles. Driver 1
was traveling in the northbound lane when the front of the vehicle struck the front of Driver 2's vehicle as Driver 2
attempted to pull into the lane. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage consistent with the impact described by the
drivers. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and was evaluated at the scene. A Passenger was also
seated in Driver 1's vehicle and was confirmed by officers and independent witnesses to have been present during
the crash. Several witnesses on the sidewalk described the collision as I have recorded it, and photographs taken at
the scene match these accounts. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events. A few small scratches on the rear
bumper of Driver 1's vehicle may predate this incident and have been noted separately. Driver 1 stated they reside in
the same household as the registered policyholder of the vehicle.
